minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  August 25, 2020

  The Housing Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, August 25, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
  hour of 2:01 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority
  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agenda.
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer, spoke concerning Agenda Item No. DR-2, authorization
  to pay invoices (Nos. 2000278207 and 2000312392) submitted by AECOM Technical
  Services, Inc., for design support services on the Century Boulevard Mobility
  Improvement Project (Project P212).

  Dillion (last name unknown) spoke concerning Agenda Item No. 2, Rejection of Claims.

  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke concerning Agenda Item Nos. 7, approval of an
  agreement with the State of California for acceptance of the Fiscal Year 2021 Office of
  Traffic Safety grant funds in the total amount of $254,500, and 8, acceptance and
  approval of the recommendations of the Chief of Police pertaining to the expenditure of
  Fiscal Year 2020 Justice Assistance Grant Funds.

  Ms. Craft spoke concerning Agenda Item No. 7, approval of an agreement with the State
  of California for acceptance of the Fiscal Year 2021 Office of Traffic Safety grant funds
  in the total amount of $254,500.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Mayor/Successor
  Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Franklin, and seconded by Council
  Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Padilla that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  August 20, 2020, in the amount of $2,841,423.59 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.
 August 25, 2020

 131.8  RESOLUTION NOS. 20-124 AND H20-04 ADOPTED – APPROVING FIRST
  AMENDMENT TO DDA WITH BEACH AVE HOUSING, LP (AGREEMENT
  NO. 20-163B); MAYOR/CHAIRMAN AUTHORIZED - EXECUTE AND
  IMPLEMENT DDA, AS AMENDED. Staff report dated August 25, 2020, was
  presented recommending adoption of a resolution approving the First Amendment to the
  Disposition and Development Agreement (First Amendment ) by and among the City of
  Inglewood, Inglewood Housing Authority, as housing successor to the former Inglewood
  Redevelopment Agency (“Authority”), and Beach Avenue Housing, LP, a California
  limited partnership (“Developer”) providing for certain changes to that certain
  Disposition and Development Agreement dated March 4, 2020 (the “DDA”) relating to
  common open space, parking, unit size and manager’s unit bedroom designation with
  respect to the development of a 42-Unit affordable housing rental project (the “Project”)
  located at 716 through 730 West Beach Avenue, Inglewood, California 90301 (the
  “Site”).

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Morales
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 20-124 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD,  CALIFORNIA,  APPROVING THE FIRST
  AMENDMENT TO THE DISPOSITION AND DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT BY AND AMONG THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  INGLEWOOD HOUSING AUTHORITY, AND BEACH AVENUE
  HOUSING, LP FOR THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECT
  LOCATED AT 716-730 W. BEACH AVENUE

  and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute and to implement the DDA, as amended by the
  proposed First Amendment. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Padilla, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Morales that the Housing Authority does hereby: 1) Adopt Resolution
  No. H20-04 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS OF THE
  INGLEWOOD HOUSING AUTHORITY APPROVING THE FIRST
  AMENDMENT TO THE DISPOSITION AND DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT BY AND AMONG THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  INGLEWOOD HOUSING AUTHORITY, AND BEACH AVENUE
  HOUSING, LP FOR THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECT
  LOCATED AT 716-730 W. BEACH AVENUE

  and 2) Authorized the Chairman to execute and implement the DDA, as amended by the
  proposed First Amendment. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.
  There being no further business to be presented, Housing Authority Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:36 p.m.

  Approved this 20th day of April, 2021

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
